datasheet_identity.title: TPZXMP3A13FTA P-Channel Enhancement Mode MOSFET

extraction_notes: This is a p-channel MOSFET. Datasheet voltage and current signs are preserved in threshold, drain-source, and body-diode fields; RDS(on) is positive resistance.
The datasheet provides no typical threshold-voltage scalar; threshold_typ is null. The typical threshold-variation curve is temperature-dependent and not a room-temperature table value.
RDS(on) is 60 mOhm typical and 90 mOhm maximum at VGS = -10 V, ID = -3 A; 75 mOhm typical and 110 mOhm maximum at VGS = -4.5 V, ID = -2 A, p. 2.

Total gate charge is 10 nC typical and 15 nC maximum; Qgs is 1.9 nC typical and Qgd is 2 nC typical at VDS = -15 V, ID = -3 A, VGS = -10 V, p. 2. These fields are not represented by the strict schema.
Thermal resistances are RthetaJC = 75 degC/W and RthetaJA = 130 degC/W, p. 2; these fields are not represented by the strict schema.
Curve points are manual reads from p. 3 Figure 1 and Figure 5. Figure 1 includes grouped curves from VGS = -5 V through -10 V; the grouped high-gate-drive curve is labeled in the plot.
Correction (2026-08-11): pF labels in the p. 2 Dynamic table and p. 3 Figure 5 were converted to SI F; capacitance values and curve points are corrected by 1/1000.
omission_reason: The strict schema does not represent gate charge, switching times, thermal resistances, or safe-operating-area data. No separate transfer-characteristic figure is published; output and capacitance curves are available and recorded.
